description: Start a full audit for one verified site owned by this API key. This is the call that commits finding state (resolved / regressed) and feeds trends and health. Depth defaults to the site's configured audit depth: standard runs the core rule set (indexability, compliance, agent readiness); deep adds performance, media, accessibility detail and the extended schema rules. It reserves audit page checks from the account's monthly pool (settled by successfully fetched pages) and queues the run when the account or global audit capacity is busy; a queued result includes queuePosition and queueEtaSeconds. Requires the audits:write scope. Writes need confirm:true plus a unique idempotencyKey; without confirm:true it returns a dry-run preview and changes nothing. Reusing the same idempotencyKey within 24h returns the first result.

depth.description: standard (default) runs the core rule set; deep runs every applicable rule.

name: run_audit
title: Run an audit now
